import random, sys, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import reference
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def constraints_ok(core_paths, core):
    index = {l:i for i,l in enumerate(core)}
    occ = {i: [] for i in range(len(core))}
    for p, c in core_paths.items():
        for i in range(len(p)-1):
            e = (min(p[i],p[i+1]), max(p[i],p[i+1]))
            L, R = reference.context_types(p, i, e)
            occ[index[e]].append((c, L, R))
    for assign in itertools.product(range(3), repeat=len(core)):
        st = dict(zip(range(len(core)), assign))
        ok = True
        for e in range(len(core)):
            allowed = False
            for c, L, R in occ[e]:
                lv = L[1] if L[0]=='const' else (reference.INV[st[index[L[1]]]] if L[2] else st[index[L[1]]])
                rv = R[1] if R[0]=='const' else (reference.INV[st[index[R[1]]]] if R[2] else st[index[R[1]]])
                if reference.G[(lv,rv)] == assign[e]:
                    allowed = True
            if not allowed:
                ok = False
                break
        if ok:
            return True
    return False

rng = random.Random(11)
found = 0
for trial in range(300000):
    nasn = rng.randint(3,5)
    asns = list(range(1, nasn+1))
    paths = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3,7)):
        L = rng.randint(2,5)
        p = []
        for _ in range(L):
            a = rng.choice(asns)
            if p and p[-1]==a: continue
            p.append(a)
        if len(set(p))!=len(p) or len(p)<2: continue
        paths.append(tuple(p))
    paths = list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
    if len(paths) < 3: continue
    core_paths, rounds = reference.peel({p:1 for p in paths})
    if not core_paths: continue
    core = sorted(set().union(*[reference.links_of(p) for p in core_paths]))
    if len(core) > 7: continue
    if constraints_ok(core_paths, core):
        continue
    # verify with the brute force reference
    agg = {p:1 for p in paths}
    cp2, _ = reference.peel(agg)
    c2, marg, Z = reference.marginals(cp2)
    print('CANDIDATE Z =', Z)
    print(' paths:', paths)
    print(' core paths:', cp2)
    found += 1
    if found >= 3: break
print('done, found', found)
PYEOF
